Assessments of the federal government have improved again. Fifty-nine percent of Canadians approve of the job the federal government led by Mark Carney is doing. Twenty-seven percent disapprove, while 15% neither approve nor disapprove.

Compared with two weeks ago, approval is up three points and disapproval is down two. That moves the government’s net approval rating from +27 to +32. [...] A majority, 52%, also approve of its handling of national defence and Canada’s security, essentially unchanged from 50% two weeks ago.

After that, approval falls below 50%.
